answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond that unlocks only after a long vesting window, like a vine that must grow before it bears weight. New identities start inside a narrow trust canyon: they may transact only small amounts through a wharf of vetted counterparties, and their bond is slashed if peers attest fraud. Cloning an identity therefore costs a fresh bond plus the waiting time, while an established agent keeps cheap access, so a Sybil farm pays linearly per fake identity and earns nothing until vesting passes, making mass fakery unprofitable.
